titles: 고속도로 점선은 왜 짧아 보일까 (feat. 실제로 재 보면 8m)
고속도로 점선은 왜 짧아 보일까? 실제로 재 보면 8m인 이유
고속도로 점선이 하필 8m인 이유 (feat. 6m로 칠했다가 되돌렸다?)
thumbnail_texts: {고속도로 점선}은 한 뼘처럼 보이는데 / 왜 실제로는 [8m]일까

image_concepts.A: 두 시점 대비 — 왼쪽 운전석 앞 유리 너머 짧은 흰 토막들, 오른쪽 위에서 내려다본 같은 흰 선 하나 옆에 승용차를 눕혀 길이 비교(주황 치수선)
image_concepts.B: 스케일 비틀기 — 고속도로 위로 펼쳐진 거대한 줄자가 흰 점선 하나를 재고, 옆을 지나는 승용차는 작게

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 좌우 분할. 왼쪽은 승용차 운전석에서 앞 유리 너머로 본 고속도로 — 흰 점선이 손가락 마디만 한 짧은 토막으로 줄지어 멀어진다. 오른쪽은 같은 차로를 바로 위에서 내려다본 장면 — 흰 선 하나가 길게 누워 있고, 그 옆에 은색 중형 승용차 한 대 반 길이가 나란히 놓여 선이 훨씬 길다는 게 보인다. 선 옆에 주황 치수선(숫자 없음).
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A split-screen composition of the same Korean expressway lane. Left half: the view from a car's driver seat through the windshield, the white dashed lane line ahead looks like a row of tiny short stubs shrinking toward the horizon, green mountains and a bright teal sky. Right half: a top-down view of the same lane, one single long white painted dash lying on dark grey asphalt, and right beside it a silver mid-size sedan parked parallel, clearly shorter than the white dash, with a glowing orange measuring bracket running along the full length of the dash. Clean, bright daylight.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 변형 — 내려다보기(D). 높은 조감 시점에서 본 왕복 고속도로, 흰 점선이 길게 이어지고 한 칸(선 하나)에만 주황 빛 테두리. 그 선 하나 위에 승용차 두 대보다 조금 짧게 겹쳐 보이도록 반투명 승용차 실루엣 두 개가 나란히 놓여 있다. 한쪽 차로엔 실제 차량 몇 대가 작게 달린다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A high aerial bird's-eye view of a multi-lane Korean expressway winding between green hills on a sunny day. The white dashed lane lines repeat in long even segments with longer gaps between them. One single white dash in the center is outlined with a glowing warm orange rim, and two translucent ghostly sedan silhouettes are placed end to end on top of that one dash, together slightly longer than the dash itself, showing how long one painted line really is. A few small real cars travel in the other lanes.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 스케일 비틀기(C). 고속도로 위로 거대한 노란 줄자가 길게 펼쳐져 흰 점선 하나의 처음과 끝에 정확히 맞춰져 있다. 줄자 옆 차로를 지나는 승용차는 줄자 폭보다 작아 보인다. 눈금은 그리되 숫자는 없음.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A giant bright yellow retractable tape measure, as big as a truck, lies stretched along a Korean expressway, its metal tape pulled out exactly from the start to the end of one white painted lane dash, with tick marks but no numbers. The huge tape measure case sits on the road shoulder. A small silver car drives past in the next lane, dwarfed by the tape. Low-angle perspective from the road surface, green mountains and a clear teal sky.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 변형 — 원리 시각화(F). 운전석 높이의 눈에서 앞쪽 도로로 퍼져 나가는 빛나는 시선 선들. 바닥에 누운 흰 선 하나에 닿는 시선 선은 아주 좁게 모이고, 같은 거리의 차로 폭 양 끝에 닿는 시선 선은 넓게 벌어진다. 화살표·글자 없음, 청록 빛 선.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A side cutaway view of a sedan driving on a Korean expressway, showing a driver's eye position low inside the car. From the eye, glowing teal sight lines fan out toward the road ahead: two sight lines touching the front and back ends of one long white lane dash lying flat on the asphalt far ahead are squeezed into a very thin sliver, while two sight lines touching the left and right edges of the lane at the same distance spread out wide. The flat white dash glows warm orange. No arrows, no text, only glowing lines.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드 결정적 순간 정지(G) + 유머 1개. 시속 100km로 달리는 승용차 바로 옆, 흰 점선 하나가 휙 지나가는 순간을 멈춘 장면 — 바퀴와 배경은 속도감 있게 흐리고 흰 선 하나만 또렷하다. 선 위에 작은 줄자를 든 미니어처 도로 작업자 인형이 놀란 얼굴로 선 끝을 재고 있다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A frozen moment at high speed on a Korean expressway: a sedan rushes past with motion-blurred wheels and streaking background, while one white lane dash beside it stays perfectly sharp. On top of that dash stands a tiny miniature road-worker figurine in an orange safety vest, holding a small yellow tape measure stretched toward the far end of the dash, with a surprised face. Playful and curious mood, bright daylight.
